title: The gap step files an off-kb question as a gap under an unrelated article when its pack is weak
goal: ql_apply.gap_one rejects at candidate-gap, as off the kb's domains, a weak candidate whose lead article lacks the question's subject (the logged 'What is the maximum email attachment size?', lead mecm/collect-client-logs); test_gap_step_rejects_weak_off_domain proves it, the existing gap-step tests and rag.py eval still pass, and querylog.md and querylog.py apply help state the weak rule

gates.question: The off-kb _gaps.md entry under mecm/collect-client-logs (F-bd7367a45f3a) is kb content: remove it once the gap step rejects such candidates, or keep it with a Tried note (querylog.py close --tried)?
options: remove the entry and record the finding rejected
keep the entry with a Tried note
gates.recommendation: remove the entry and record the finding rejected: no topic can take the question, and the research queue would spend a run on it
gates.answer: remove the entry and record the finding rejected

links: kb/public/_gaps.md entry 'What is the maximum email attachment size?' (topic mecm/collect-client-logs)
notes: gap_one guards only a none lead (more than half the key words); a weak lead passes whatever word it lacks. The pack gives weak with 3 of 4 key words (attachment, maximum, size) and lacks email, the question's subject. The rule that tells a subject word from a qualifier is the fix's design; it must not move any rag.py eval row.
